sql: SELECT yhbh, yhmc, ydsz, gddw, ydlb, hylb, dydj, htrl, yhzt, lhrq, lxr, lxdh FROM ads_yx_khda_cx WHERE yhbh = '3523000123456'
SELECT * FROM ads_yx_khda_cx WHERE gddw LIKE '%鼓楼%' AND yhzt = '1' ORDER BY lhrq DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT hh, hm, gddw, dfny, ysdf, ssdf, qfje, wyj, fxrq FROM ads_yx_qfmx_cx WHERE gddw = '台江城区供电所' ORDER BY qfje DESC
SELECT * FROM ads_yx_kh360 WHERE hh = '3561000088123'
SELECT hh, hm, gddw, ydlb, ny, ydl, ysdf FROM ads_yx_ydl_fx WHERE ny = '202508' ORDER BY ydl DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM ads_kf_gd_cx WHERE ywlx = '03' AND slsj >= '2025-08-01' ORDER BY slsj DESC
SELECT cldw, tjyf, gdzs, tsgds, bxgds, tsl, pjmyd FROM ads_kf_gd_kb WHERE tjyf = '2025-08'
SELECT hh, hm, gddw, htrl, rq, zdfh, pjfh, fzl FROM ads_cj_dkh_fh WHERE rq = '2025-12-29' AND fzl > 0.8

SELECT k.gddw_mc, COUNT(DISTINCT q.hh) AS qf_hs, ROUND(SUM(q.qfje), 2) AS qf_je
FROM dwd_yx_df_ysmx q JOIN dwd_yx_kh_jbxx k ON k.hh = q.hh
WHERE q.jqbz = '0' GROUP BY k.gddw_mc ORDER BY qf_je DESC

SELECT k.ydlb, q.dfny, ROUND(SUM(q.jsdl), 2) AS dl, ROUND(SUM(q.ysje), 2) AS je
FROM dwd_yx_df_ysmx q JOIN dwd_yx_kh_jbxx k ON k.hh = q.hh
GROUP BY k.ydlb, q.dfny ORDER BY q.dfny

SELECT j.jffs, COUNT(*) AS bs, ROUND(SUM(j.jfje), 2) AS je
FROM dwd_yx_jf_mx j WHERE j.jfsj >= '2025-07-01' GROUP BY j.jffs

SELECT c.hh, c.cbny, c.cjdl, y.jsdl, ROUND(c.cjdl - y.jsdl, 2) AS diff
FROM dwd_yx_cbsz c JOIN dwd_yx_df_ysmx y ON y.hh = c.hh AND y.dfny = c.cbny
WHERE ABS(c.cjdl - y.jsdl) > 0.01

SELECT r.hh, ROUND(SUM(r.zxygdl), 2) AS cj_dl, y.jsdl AS yx_dl
FROM dwd_cj_rdl r JOIN dwd_yx_df_ysmx y ON y.hh = r.hh AND y.dfny = '202512'
WHERE r.sjrq BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.hh, y.jsdl

SELECT j.jldbh, j.dnbzcbh, j.zhbl, r.sjrq, r.zxygsz, r.zxygdl
FROM dwd_yx_jld_xx j JOIN dwd_cj_rdl r ON r.dnbzcbh = j.dnbzcbh
WHERE r.sjrq = '2025-12-15'

SELECT g.cldw, g.ywlx, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(g.hfpf), 2) AS score
FROM dwd_kf_gd_mx g WHERE g.slsj LIKE '2025-0%' GROUP BY g.cldw, g.ywlx

SELECT g.hh, k.hm, k.ydsz, COUNT(*) AS bx_cs
FROM dwd_kf_gd_mx g JOIN dwd_yx_kh_jbxx k ON k.hh = g.hh
WHERE g.ywlx = '01' GROUP BY g.hh, k.hm, k.ydsz HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

SELECT z.gddw_mc, z.zdlx, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dwd_cj_zd_xx z
WHERE z.yxzt = '1' GROUP BY z.gddw_mc, z.zdlx

SELECT k.hh, k.hm, k.htrl, MAX(f.yggl) AS max_p
FROM dwd_cj_fhqx f JOIN dwd_yx_kh_jbxx k ON k.hh = f.hh
GROUP BY k.hh, k.hm, k.htrl HAVING MAX(f.yggl) > k.htrl * 0.9

SELECT c.cons_no, c.cons_name, c.elec_addr, o.org_name
FROM ods_yx186_c_cons c JOIN ods_yx186_o_org o ON o.org_no = c.org_no
WHERE c.status_code = '9'

SELECT w.app_no, w.cust_no, c.cons_no, w.cust_name, c.cons_name
FROM ods_kf95598_t_kf_workorder w LEFT JOIN ods_yx186_c_cons c ON c.cons_no = w.cust_no
WHERE c.cons_name IS NULL OR TRIM(w.cust_name) <> c.cons_name

SELECT m.mp_no, d.asset_no, p.meter_asset_no, d.t_factor, p.t_factor
FROM ods_yx186_c_mp m JOIN ods_yx186_c_meter_mp_rela r ON r.mp_id = m.mp_id
JOIN ods_yx186_d_meter d ON d.meter_id = r.meter_id
JOIN ods_cjxt_e_data_mp p ON p.mp_id = m.mp_id
WHERE d.t_factor <> p.t_factor OR d.asset_no <> p.meter_asset_no

SELECT q.hh, q.qfys, q.ljqfje, j.zjjfsj FROM dws_yx_kh_qf_hz q
LEFT JOIN dws_yx_kh_jf_hz j ON j.hh = q.hh WHERE q.qfys >= 2
SELECT hh, hm, ydsz FROM dwd_yx_kh_jbxx_bak WHERE hh LIKE '3512%'
SELECT * FROM tmp_qf_hh_20251201 ORDER BY qfje DESC LIMIT 20
